1191: ਲਬੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨਾ; ਅਉਗਣ ਪੈਰਿ ਲੁਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Greed is a dark prison, and one's faults are iron shackles on the feet. ॥3॥
ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਮੁਦਗਰ; ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਕੋੁਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
Our capital is the constant beating of clubs, and sin acts as the jailer.
ਭਾਵੈ ਚੰਗਾ. ਭਾਵੈ ਮੰਦਾ; ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Whether good or bad, we become as Your glance makes us. ॥4॥
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਅਲਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ; ਸੇਖਾਂ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
The Primal Being is now called Allah; the turn of the Shaikhs has come.
ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ. ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ; ਐਸੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਚਾਲੀ ॥੫॥
The temples of the gods are taxed; such is the custom that has spread. ॥5॥
ਕੂਜਾ ਬਾਂਗ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਮੁਸਲਾ; ਨੀਲ ਰੂਪ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
The ablution pot, the call to prayer, prayer and the prayer mat prevail; the Lord's worshippers wear blue.
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੀਆ. ਸਭਨਾਂ ਜੀਆਂ; ਬੋਲੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
In every home all say "Mian"; Your people now speak another language. ॥6॥
ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੀਰ ਮਹੀਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
If You, the Sovereign and Lord of the earth, so will it, what power do we have to object?
ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ; ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Those in all four directions bow to You; in every home Your praise is sung. ॥7॥
ਤੀਰਥ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ; ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ॥
Whatever profit comes from pilgrimages, Simritis, charity and alms is but a day's wage;
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਮੇਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਸਮੑਾਲੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
Nanak, through the Name comes glory, by remembering it even for a moment. ॥8॥1॥8॥
Basant Hindol · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 2
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਾਂਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ. ਇਕੁ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ; ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਥਿਰੁ. ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
In the city of the body dwells a child that cannot stay still even for an instant.
ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
People grow weary of trying countless means and efforts; again and again it wanders. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਬਾਲਕੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੁ ॥
O my Master, bring the child home to one place.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meeting the True Guru, the perfect Lord is found; meditate on the Lord's Name, the passport. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਮੜਾ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ. ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
This body is a corpse, a heap of dust, as is the whole world, if the Lord's Name does not dwell in it.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ. ਉਦਕੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ; ਫਿਰਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਿਆ ॥੨॥
The Guru poured the water of the Lord's Name into its mouth, and it became green and full of life again. ॥2॥
ਮੈ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ. ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ; ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Looking and looking, I searched my whole body; the Guru showed me a wondrous play.
ਬਾਹਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
The faithless all died searching outside; through the Guru's teaching I found the Lord at home. ॥3॥
ਦੀਨਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ; ਜਿਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ. ਬਿਦਰ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
God has always been merciful to the poorest of the poor, as when Krishna came to Bidar's house.
ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ. ਭਾਵਨੀ ਧਾਰਿ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਗੈ. ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Sudama met him with faith, and even before he returned home, his poverty was gone and everything had arrived. ॥4॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਵਡੇਰੀ; ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
Great is the honour of the Lord's Name; my Master Himself has preserved it.
ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ; ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤਿਲੁ. ਨ ਘਟਾਈ ॥੫॥
Even if all the faithless slander them, He does not let it diminish a particle. ॥5॥
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
The Lord's Name is the praise of His servant; he gains glory in all ten directions.
ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ. ਖਵਿ, ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਲੁ; ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੂਕੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
The faithless slanderer cannot bear it at all; he has set fire to his own home. ॥6॥
ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ; ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Meeting a devotee, a devotee gains glory; virtue is revealed in virtue.
ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਜੋ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
The servants of my Master are dear to the Beloved — those who become slaves of His slaves. ॥7॥
ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
The infinite Creator is Himself the water; He Himself unites in union.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
Nanak, through the Guru He unites one in poise, as water merges with water. ॥8॥1॥9॥
1192: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Listen to the teaching, O mind, and chant with love.
Ajamal was saved by uttering the Name;
Valmiki found the company of the holy;
Dhru met the Lord face to face. ॥1॥
I beg for the dust of the feet of Your saints;
ਲੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਵਉ; ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
be merciful and grant it, that I may apply it to my forehead. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Ganika was saved as the parrot uttered the Lord's Name;
the elephant meditated, and the Lord set him free;
He dispelled the poverty of the Brahmin Sudama;
ਰੇ ਮਨ; ਤੂ ਭੀ ਭਜੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
O mind, you too meditate on the Lord of the universe. ॥2॥
Even the hunter who shot Krishna with an arrow was saved;
Kubija was saved by the touch of His thumb;
Bidar was saved by his spirit of service;
ਰੇ ਮਨ; ਤੂ ਭੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
O mind, you too meditate on the Lord. ॥3॥
The Lord Himself preserved Prahlad's honour;
when Draupadi was being stripped, her honour was saved.
All who served the Lord in their hour of need were saved;
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਿ; ਤੂ ਪਰਹਿ ਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
O mind, serve Him, and you shall cross over. ॥4॥
Dhanna served the Lord with the innocence of a child;
meeting the Guru, Trilochan attained spiritual perfection;
ਰੇ ਮਨ; ਤੂ ਭੀ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
O mind, you too become His servant. ॥5॥
Sain the barber was saved through devoted service;
ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਹੂੰ ਜਾਇ ॥
his mind did not stumble or waver anywhere;
ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਤਰਸਹਿ; ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
O mind, you too shall cross over by seeking the sanctuary. ॥6॥
Those on whom You, the Master, Yourself showed grace —
ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਗੁਣੁ; ਅਵਗਣੁ. ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਕੋਇ ॥
You did not consider their merits or faults;
ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੇਖਿ; ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੭॥
seeing such ways, my mind has taken to Your service. ॥7॥
Kabir meditated on the Lord with unwavering love;
Ravidas meditated on the incomparable God;
Guru Nanak Dev is the embodiment of the Lord of the universe. ॥8॥1॥
Through countless births people wander among the species;
without remembering the Lord, they fall into hell.
Without devotion, the mind is shattered into pieces;
without understanding, the messenger of death punishes them. ॥1॥
Meditate on the Lord of the universe, my friend, always;
ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ; ਕਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ever love the True Word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
all Maya's displays are clouds of smoke.
One does not hesitate to commit sin;
intoxicated with poison, one keeps coming and going. ॥2॥
the world is drowned in attachment and greed.
Lust and anger have taken control of the mind;
one has not taken the Lord's Name even in dreams. ॥3॥
Sometimes a king, sometimes a beggar,
the world is bound by pain and pleasure.
One makes no effort to save the mind,
and the bonds of sin keep tightening. ॥4॥
No dear friend is a true companion;
people themselves sow and themselves eat.
1193: The things whose gathering produces vice —
ਸੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
the fool leaves them behind in an instant and departs. ॥5॥
Through attachment to Maya one wanders greatly,
acting according to the record of past deeds.
neither virtue nor sin clings to God. ॥6॥
Save me, O merciful Lord of the universe;
I seek Your sanctuary, O all-pervading, kind Lord.
Without You I have no other place;
in Your mercy, God, bless me with Your Name. ॥7॥
You are the Creator, You are the doer;
You are lofty, You are utterly infinite.
In Your mercy, attach me to Your hem;
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੈ; ਹੋਹੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
Meditating on the Lord's Name, become green with life, O brother.
ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖੰਤੈ ਪਾਈਐ; ਇਹ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
By the writ of grace one obtains this beautiful season.
ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
The forests, the grass and the three worlds blossom; one obtains the nectar fruit.
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਲਥੀ ਸਭ ਛਾਈ ॥
Meeting the holy Guru, peace wells up and all filth is washed away.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
Nanak remembers the one Name, and does not wander again and again. ॥1॥
ਪੰਜੇ ਬਧੇ ਮਹਾਬਲੀ; ਕਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
The five mighty passions are bound for one who has made the true offering;
ਆਪਣੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪਾਇਅਨੁ; ਵਿਚਿ ਦਯੁ ਖੜੋਆ ॥
the Merciful Lord stands within and makes him meditate on His feet.
ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ; ਨਿਤ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
All disease and sorrow are gone; he is ever fresh and healthy.
ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇ. ਨ ਮੋਆ ॥
Day and night he meditates on the Name and does not die again.
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
Nanak, he becomes one with the One from whom he came. ॥2॥
ਕਿਥਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ. ਕਹ ਰਹੈ; ਕਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Where does He arise from, where does He dwell, into what does He merge?
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ. ਖਸਮ ਕੇ; ਕਉਣੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
All beings belong to the Master; who can estimate His worth?
ਕਹਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੁਣਨਿ ਨਿਤ; ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
Those devotees who speak of Him, meditate and listen to Him daily are beautiful.
ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ; ਦੂਸਰੁ. ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
The Master is inaccessible and beyond the senses; no one else can compare to Him.
ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੧॥
The perfect Guru has taught the Truth, and Nanak proclaims it. ॥3॥1॥
ਬਸੰਤੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Basant · Bhagat Bani · Bhagat Kabir · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The earth has blossomed, the sky has blossomed;
in each and every heart the light of the Supreme Soul has blossomed. ॥1॥
The sovereign Lord blossoms forth in countless ways;
ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ; ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
wherever I look, there He is pervading. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Secondly, the four Vedas have blossomed forth,
as have the Simritis along with the Semitic scriptures. ॥2॥
Shiva, in his yogic meditation, has blossomed;
The pandits are intoxicated with reading the Puranas;
the yogis are intoxicated with yogic meditation;
the renunciates are intoxicated with ego;
the ascetics are intoxicated with the secret of austerity. ॥1॥
ਸਭ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ; ਕੋਊ. ਨ ਜਾਗ ॥
All are intoxicated with the wine of pride; no one is awake.
ਸੰਗ ਹੀ ਚੋਰ; ਘਰੁ ਮੁਸਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Thieves within are robbing the house. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1194: Hanuman with his tail is awake;
Shiva is awake, serving the Lord's feet;
in this Dark Age, Namdev and Jaidev are awake. ॥2॥
There are many kinds of waking and sleeping;
to be awake as Guru-facing is the most excellent.
The greatest work of this body
says Kabir, is to meditate on the Lord's Name. ॥3॥2॥
The wife has given birth to her husband;
the son leads his father in play;
without breasts, she gives milk to drink. ॥1॥
Behold, people, the influence of the Dark Age:
the son has married his own mother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
without a mouth, he bursts into laughter;
without sleepiness, the man lies down and sleeps;
without a vessel, he churns milk. ॥2॥
Without udders, the cow gives milk;
without a journey, the road is long.
Without the True Guru the way is not found;
and he took many young friends with him.
ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਪੜੑਾਵਸਿ; ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ॥
"Why do you teach me this nonsense?
ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਹੁ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
Write the name of the Lord of the world on my slate." ॥1॥
ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡਉ. ਰੇ ਬਾਬਾ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥
"I will not give up the Lord's Name, O teacher;
ਮੇਰੋ ਅਉਰ ਪੜੑਨ ਸਿਉ; ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have nothing to do with any other study." ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Sanda and Marka went and complained,
ਤੂ. ਰਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਕੀ ਛੋਡੁ ਬਾਨਿ ॥
"Give up your habit of uttering the Lord's Name;
ਤੁਝੁ ਤੁਰਤੁ ਛਡਾਊ; ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
heed what I say, and I will have you released at once." ॥2॥
ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਸਤਾਵਹੁ; ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
"Why do you torment me again and again?
ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਹਾਰ ॥
God made the water, the land, the hills and mountains.
ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਗੁਰਹਿ ਗਾਰਿ ॥
I will not give up the one Lord; to do so would disgrace my Guru.
ਮੋ ਕਉ ਘਾਲਿ ਜਾਰਿ; ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Burn me or kill me, as you please." ॥3॥
The king drew his sword and flew into a rage:
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਥੰਭ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ; ਕੈ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
God emerged from the pillar in a mighty form,
and tore Harnakhash apart with His nails. ॥4॥
He is the supreme Being, the God of gods;
for the sake of devotion He took the form of the man-lion.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ; ਕੋ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
Says Kabir, no one can know His limits;
He saved Prahlad again and again. ॥5॥4॥
ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ; ਮਦਨ ਚੋਰ ॥
Within this body and mind dwells the thief of lust,
ਜਿਨਿ; ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
who has stolen my jewel of spiritual wisdom.
I am helpless, O God; to whom can I complain?
ਕੋ ਕੋ. ਨ ਬਿਗੂਤੋ; ਮੈ ਕੋ ਆਹਿ ॥੧॥
Who has not been ruined by it? What am I? ॥1॥
ਮਾਧਉ ਦਾਰੁਨ ਦੁਖੁ; ਸਹਿਓ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
O Lord, I cannot endure this terrible pain;
ਮੇਰੋ ਚਪਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਉ; ਕਹਾ ਬਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
what power do I have against my fickle intellect? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Sanak, Sanandan, Shiva, Sukdev and the rest,
Brahma and others born from the lotus of the navel,
poets, yogis and those with matted hair —
all passed their time and departed. ॥2॥
You are unfathomable; I cannot know Your depth.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਉ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
O God, Master of the meek, to whom else can I tell my pain?
ਮੋਰੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ; ਆਥਿ ਧੀਰ ॥
Take away my pain of birth and death, born of Maya, and give me steadiness,
O ocean of peace, that Kabir may dwell on Your virtues. ॥3॥5॥
There is one merchant and five traders;
the twenty-five oxen are a flimsy company.
There are nine poles and ten sacks,
ਮੋਹਿ ਐਸੇ ਬਨਜ ਸਿਉ; ਨਹੀਨ ਕਾਜੁ ॥
I want nothing to do with such trade,
1195: ਜਿਹ ਘਟੈ ਮੂਲੁ; ਨਿਤ ਬਢੈ ਬਿਆਜੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in which the capital dwindles and the interest grows daily. ॥ Rahao ॥
Weaving together the seven threads, they carry on their trade,
taking along the impressions of past deeds.
The three tax collectors quarrel with them,
The capital is lost, the trade is ruined,
and the caravan is scattered in ten directions.
Says Kabir, O mind, your task will succeed
if you merge in intuitive poise and your doubt runs away. ॥3॥6॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮਾਤਾ ਜੂਠੀ. ਪਿਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੂਠਾ. ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
The mother is impure, the father too is impure, and the fruit they bear is impure.
ਆਵਹਿ ਜੂਠੇ. ਜਾਹਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੇ; ਜੂਠੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
Impure they come, impure they go; the unfortunate die impure. ॥1॥
Tell me, pandit, which place is pure,
ਜਹਾਂ ਬੈਸਿ; ਹਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
where I may sit and eat my meal? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਹਬਾ ਜੂਠੀ. ਬੋਲਤ ਜੂਠਾ; ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਜੂਠੇ ॥
The tongue is impure, speech is impure, the ears and eyes are all impure.
ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੇ ਲੂਠੇ ॥੨॥
The impurity of the sexual organ never departs; O you, burnt by the fire of Brahmin pride! ॥2॥
ਅਗਨਿ ਭੀ ਜੂਠੀ. ਪਾਨੀ ਜੂਠਾ; ਜੂਠੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
The fire is impure, the water is impure, and impure is the woman who sits and cooks.
ਜੂਠੀ ਕਰਛੀ ਪਰੋਸਨ ਲਾਗਾ; ਜੂਠੇ ਹੀ ਬੈਠਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Impure is the ladle that serves the food; impure is the one who sits to eat. ॥3॥
ਗੋਬਰੁ ਜੂਠਾ. ਚਉਕਾ ਜੂਠਾ; ਜੂਠੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
The cow dung is impure, the cooking square is impure, impure are the lines drawn around it.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਤੇਈ ਨਰ ਸੂਚੇ; ਸਾਚੀ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
Says Kabir, they alone are pure who have attained true understanding of God. ॥4॥1॥7॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਰੇ; ਘਰ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Where should I go? There is joy in my own home.
ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ. ਨ ਚਲੈ; ਮਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My consciousness no longer wanders; my mind has become still. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One day a longing arose in my mind;
I ground sandalwood and took perfumes and many fragrances,
and set out to worship at the temple of God.
ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ; ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
But the Guru showed me that God within my own mind. ॥1॥
Wherever I go, I find water and stones;
ਤੂ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
I have searched through all the Vedas and Puranas;
ਊਹਾਂ ਤਉ ਜਾਈਐ; ਜਉ ਈਹਾਂ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
one would go there only if the Lord were not here. ॥2॥
O True Guru, I am a sacrifice to You,
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ; ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਰ ॥
who have cut away all my confusion and doubt.
Ramanand's Master is the all-pervading God;
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥੧॥
the Guru's Word erases millions of past deeds. ॥3॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
If the master puts his servant through hardship and the servant runs away,
ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ. ਨ ਜੀਵੈ; ਦੋਊ ਕੁਲ ਲਜੈ ॥੧॥
he does not live forever, and he disgraces both his families. ॥1॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਭਾਵੈ ਲੋਗੁ ਹਸੈ ॥
I will not abandon devotion to You, even if people laugh at me;
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ; ਮੇਰੇ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਬਸੈਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your lotus feet dwell within my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਧਨਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਰਨੁ ਮਾਂਡੈ ॥
As a person will face death for the sake of his wealth,
ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਛਾਡੈਂ ॥੨॥
so the saints do not give up the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਗੰਗਾ ਗਇਆ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ; ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
Pilgrimages to the Ganges, Gaya and the Godavari are worldly affairs;
1196: ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਇ; ਤ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
Only when the Lord is pleased is one His servant, says Nama. ॥3॥1॥
ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ. ਅਤਿ ਨੀਝਰ ਬਾਜੈ ॥ ਕਾਇਆ ਡੂਬੈ, ਕੇਸਵਾ ॥੧॥
The waves of greed are surging fiercely; my body is drowning, O Lord. ॥1॥
ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੇ; ਤਾਰਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੈ; ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Carry me across the world-ocean, O Lord of the universe; carry me across, Father Beethal. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਨਿਲ ਬੇੜਾ; ਹਉ ਖੇਵਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ॥ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ, ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੨॥
My boat is caught in a storm, and I cannot row it; I cannot find Your far shore, Beethal. ॥2॥
ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੂ; ਮੋ ਕਉ. ॥ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਕੇਸਵਾ ॥੩॥
Be merciful and unite me with the True Guru; carry me across, O Lord. ॥3॥
ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ; ਹਉ ਤਰਿ ਭੀ. ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥ ਮੋ ਕਉ. ਬਾਹ ਦੇਹਿ, ਬਾਹ ਦੇਹਿ; ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Says Nama, I do not even know how to swim; give me Your arm, give me Your arm, Beethal. ॥4॥2॥
ਸਹਜ ਅਵਲਿ, ਧੂੜਿ ਮਣੀ; ਗਾਡੀ ਚਾਲਤੀ ॥
Slowly at first, the cart laden with dirty clothes moves along,
and behind it she drives it on with a stick. ॥1॥
As she drives it towards the water, calling out to it,
the beloved wife sets out to the pool to wash. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The washerman, imbued with love, washes them clean;
my mind is imbued with the Lord's feet. ॥2॥
Prays Namdev, the Lord pervades everywhere,
and shows mercy to His devotees. ॥3॥3॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
You are not aware of anything;
seeing your fine clothes, you puff yourself up.
The proud bride has no place to rest;
the crow is cawing above your head. ॥1॥
Why are you so proud, you madwoman?
ਜੈਸੇ. ਭਾਦਉ ਖੂੰਬਰਾਜੁ; ਤੂ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਖਰੀ ਉਤਾਵਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You will perish even faster than a mushroom in the rainy month of Bhadon. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Like the deer, who does not know the secret —
the fragrance is in its own body, yet it searches abroad —
ਅਪ ਤਨ ਕਾ; ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
one who reflects on the nature of one's own body
is not tormented by the messenger of death. ॥2॥
You take pride in your sons and wife,
but the Master will call you to account.
The soul suffers pain for its misdeeds;
afterwards, whom will you call out to, crying "Beloved, Beloved"? ॥3॥
If you take the shelter of the holy Guru,
ਤੇਰੇ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ; ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
all your millions upon millions of sins will be erased.
Says Ravidas, one who chants the Name
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ. ਨ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
is freed of social class, of birth, and of the cycle of species. ॥4॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Your gait is like that of a cow,
and the hair on your tail is glossy. ॥1॥
ਇਸ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੈ; ਸੁ ਤੂ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Seek out and eat whatever is in your own house;
ਅਉਰ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇ; ਤੂ ਮਤਿ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
do not go to anyone else's. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You lick the grinding stone and eat the flour;
ਚਾਕੀ ਕਾ ਚੀਥਰਾ; ਕਹਾਂ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
but where will you take the rag from the mill? ॥2॥
Your eyes are fixed on the hanging basket of food;
ਮਤੁ ਲਕਰੀ ਸੋਟਾ; ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰੈ ਪੀਠਿ ॥੩॥
beware, or a stick or club will fall on your back. ॥3॥
Says Kabir, you have indulged in plenty of pleasures;
beware, or someone will strike you with a brick or a clod. ॥4॥1॥
1197: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth: the Maker, all-pervading, without fear, without enmity, beyond time, unborn, self-existent — realised by the Guru's grace.
I am the handmaid of my Master.
ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have grasped the feet of God, the Life of the world, and He has killed and finished off my ego. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
The perfect, supreme Light, the transcendent Lord, is my Beloved, my very breath of life.
ਮੋਹਨ. ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਸਮਝਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
The Enticer has enticed my mind; it understands by reflecting on the Word. ॥1॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਨ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੀ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
The self-willed one is weak, with a shallow and false intellect; there is pain in mind and body.
ਜਬ ਕੀ. ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੀਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ; ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ. ਮਨ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੨॥
Ever since I was imbued with the love of the colourful Lord, my mind has found comfort meditating on Him. ॥2॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ. ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ; ਤਬ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
Abandoning ego, I have become detached; now my consciousness is absorbed in the True Lord.
ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਬਿਸਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਲੋੁਕਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
My mind is pleased with the immaculate Lord who has no lineage; I have forgotten worldly shame. ॥3॥
ਭੂਰ ਭਵਿਖ. ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਜੈਸੇ; ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
In the past, present and future there is no one like You, my Beloved, the support of my life.
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
The happy bride is imbued with the Lord's Name; Nanak, the Lord is her Husband. ॥4॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ; ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
How can one live without the Lord? Pain afflicts one.
ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ. ਫੀਕੀ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ. ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The tongue has no sweetness and is insipid without His essence; without God, death torments one. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ. ਦਰਸੁ, ਨ ਪਰਸੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਤਬ ਲਗੁ. ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੀ ॥
As long as one does not behold the Beloved, one remains hungry and thirsty.
ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਜਲ ਰਸਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
Seeing His sight, the mind is pleased, like the lotus blossoming in the water. ॥1॥
ਊਨਵਿ ਘਨਹਰੁ, ਗਰਜੈ ਬਰਸੈ; ਕੋਕਿਲ ਮੋਰ, ਬੈਰਾਗੈ ॥
When the clouds hang low, thunder and rain, the cuckoos and peacocks are stirred with love,
ਤਰਵਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਹੰਗ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ; ਘਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
as are the trees, the bulls, the birds and the snakes; the bride whose Husband is home is blessed. ॥2॥
ਕੁਚਿਲ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ਕੁਲਖਨੀ; ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
She who has not known the poise of her Husband remains filthy, ugly, wretched and ill-mannered.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਨ. ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
Her tongue is not satisfied with the love of the Lord's essence; through evil intellect she is engulfed in pain. ॥3॥
ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ. ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਨਾ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
She does not come and go, she suffers no pain, and no pain or affliction touches her body.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ. ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Nanak, through God she is at peace in poise; beholding God, her mind is comforted. ॥4॥2॥
My beloved God is not far away.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My mind has accepted the True Guru's word; I have found the Lord, the support of my life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1198: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ. ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਨਿ; ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
In this way the bride meets her Husband Lord; she is fortunate and beloved.
ਜਾਤਿ ਬਰਨ ਕੁਲ ਸਹਸਾ ਚੂਕਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Her doubts about social class, caste and lineage are gone, reflecting on the Word through the Guru's teaching. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ. ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ, ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਹਿੰਸਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
One whose mind is convinced has no pride; she has forgotten cruelty and greed.
ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੈ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
The bride enjoys her Husband in poise; as Guru-facing she is adorned with His love. ॥2॥
ਜਾਰਉ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
I would burn such love of family and relatives, which only spreads attachment to Maya.
ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
One with no love or taste for the Lord within is caught in duality and deeds of vice. ॥3॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ. ਹਿਤ ਕੌ; ਦੁਰੈ ਨ. ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
She who has the priceless jewels of love within — the Beloved's dear one — cannot remain hidden.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ; ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
Nanak, as Guru-facing, she has enshrined the priceless Name within, age after age. ॥4॥3॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਹਮ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
I am the dust of the Lord's humble saints.
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Joining the true congregation I have attained the supreme state; the all-pervading Lord fills all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Meeting the saintly True Guru, one finds peace; all sins and sorrows are cut away.
ਆਤਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਫੂਲਿਤ; ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
The light of the soul has blossomed; I have seen the immaculate Lord present before me. ॥1॥
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
By great good fortune I found the true congregation; the Name of the Lord, Har Har, fills all.
ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਨਾਏ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Bathing in the dust of the feet of the congregation, I have bathed at the sixty-eight pilgrim places. ॥2॥
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਲੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀ; ਹਿਰਦਾ ਕੁਸੁਧੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਰੁ ॥
With evil intellect and vice, the mind is filthy and shallow; the heart is impure, attached to false love.
ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ. ਕਿਉ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
Without grace, how can one find the congregation? Caught in ego, the mind keeps grieving. ॥3॥
ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ; ਮਾਗਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Be merciful, O dear Lord, and show kindness; I beg for the dust of the feet of the congregation.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak, meeting the saintly Guru, one finds the Lord; meeting the Lord's servant, one sees the Lord present. ॥4॥1॥
I am a sacrifice to the feet of the Lord of the universe.
ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤਰਣਾ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed; chanting the Lord's Name, Har Har, one is carried across. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ; ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Faith in God has welled up in the heart; one's consciousness is focused on service and reflection.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Chant the Lord's Name in the heart night and day — the Lord of all power and virtue. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
God, inaccessible and beyond the senses, pervades all places; the unseen, infinite Lord is in mind and body.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ. ਤਬ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
When the Guru became merciful, I found Him; I beheld the unseen Lord in my heart. ॥2॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਸਰਬ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ; ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
The Name of the Lord, Support of the earth, is within all; to the egotistical faithless He seems far away.
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ. ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਬੂਝਹਿ; ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Burning in craving, they never understand; they have lost the game of life as in gambling. ॥3॥
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Those on whom the Guru has shown even a little mercy sing the Lord's praises standing and sitting.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Nanak, those blessed with His glance — He has preserved their honour. ॥4॥2॥
1199: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Bless me with the nectar of the Lord's Name, Har Har, O Beloved.
ਜਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those with whom the Guru is pleased — He resolves their affairs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦੀਨ ਭਏ. ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Those who become humble before the Guru — He removes their sorrows.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Night and day they worship before the Guru, embellished by the Guru's Word. ॥1॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ; ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਸੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
With the nectar essence of the Name in their hearts and on their tongues, they sing of it and reflect on it.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ; ਓਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
By the Guru's grace they recognise the nectar essence and find the door of liberation. ॥2॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਚਲੁ. ਅਚਲਾ ਮਤਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
The True Guru is the unshakeable Being, of steady intellect, firmly anchored in the support of the Name.
ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਵਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਹਉ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
I offer my soul to Him; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ॥3॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੇ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਬਾਰੇ ॥
The self-willed are attached to doubt and the love of duality; within them is the darkness of ignorance.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਦਰਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ. ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
They do not see the True Guru, the Giver; they reach neither this shore nor the other. ॥4॥
ਸਰਬੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
The Master pervades each and every heart, sustaining all with His power.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੫॥੩॥
Nanak, the slave of His slaves, prays: in Your mercy, save me. ॥5॥3॥
Do such work for the Lord of the universe:
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ. ਸੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whatever He does, accept it as right; as Guru-facing, stay lovingly attuned to the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੋਬਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ; ਅਵਰ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
Love for the Lord of the universe feels so sweet that all else is forgotten.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਭਇਆ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Night and day there is joy; the mind is pleased, and one's light merges into the Light. ॥1॥
ਜਬ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ. ਤਬ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ; ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
When one sings His praises, the mind is satisfied, and peace comes to dwell in it.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ. ਤਬ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
When the Guru became merciful, I found the Lord, focusing my consciousness on His feet. ॥2॥
ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
The intellect is enlightened by meditating on the Lord, lovingly attuned to the essence through spiritual wisdom.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
The Light shines within, and the mind is pleased, absorbed in the Lord in intuitive meditation. ॥3॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ. ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
Those with deceit in their hearts practise deceit continually, while reciting the Lord's Name with their mouths.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ; ਤੁਹ ਕੂਟੈ ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
Within them is greed and utter darkness; they pound husks and suffer pain. ॥4॥
ਜਬ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
When my God is pleased, one becomes devoted to Him as Guru-facing.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥
Nanak, one obtains the immaculate Name, and chanting the Name finds peace. ॥5॥4॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
My mind is pleased with the Lord's Name.
ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ; ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The True Guru has implanted love in my heart, and the sermon of the Lord, Har Har, is pleasing to my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ; ਜਨ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
Be merciful to Your humble servant, O Merciful to the meek; bless Your servant with Your inexpressible praise.
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Meeting the saints, I have found the Lord's essence; the Lord is sweet to my mind and body. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
Those who recognise the Name through the Guru's teaching are imbued with the Lord's love and detached.
ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Meeting the all-pervading Lord, they find peace, and all their coming and going ends. ॥2॥
ਨੈਣੀ ਬਿਰਹੁ. ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥
My eyes long to see God my Master; my tongue chants His Name.
1200: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
My ears hear His praises day and night; the Lord, Har Har, is dear to my heart. ॥3॥
ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ. ਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਣੇ; ਤਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ॥
When the Guru brought the five passions under control, one became detached and attuned to the Name.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
Servant Nanak: the Lord has shown mercy, and one merges in the Lord's Name. ॥4॥5॥
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜ੍ਹੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
O mind, chant the Lord's Name and study it — this is the excellent thing.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ; ਹੋਰੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Lord's Name nothing is lasting; all other display is fruitless. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਆ ਲੀਜੈ. ਕਿਆ ਤਜੀਐ ਬਉਰੇ; ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
What is there to take, and what to give up, O madman? Whatever is seen is dust.
ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਉ. ਤੁਮੑ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ; ਸਾ ਛਾਡਿ ਜਾਹੁ. ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
The poisonous wealth you believe to be your own — you will leave it behind and carry the load on your head. ॥1॥
ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ. ਅਉਧ ਫੁਨਿ ਘਾਟੈ; ਬੂਝਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ, ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
Bit by bit, moment by moment, life is running out, yet the fool cannot understand.
ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਜਿ ਸਾਥਿ, ਨ ਚਾਲੈ; ਇਹੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
He does what will not go with him; this is the way of the faithless. ॥2॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਬਉਰੇ; ਤਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Join the company of the saints, O madman, and you shall find the door of liberation.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Without the true congregation, no one has found peace; go and ask those who reflect on the Vedas. ॥3॥
ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਸਭੈ ਕੋਊ ਚਾਲੈ; ਝੂਠੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
Kings and rulers all must depart, leaving the false expanse behind.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ; ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
Nanak, the saints are eternal and unshakeable; the Lord's Name is their support. ॥4॥6॥
Sarang · Dupada · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 3
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਾਹੇ ਪੂਤ ਝਗਰਤ ਹਉ, ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਪ ॥
Why do you quarrel with your father, son?
ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਣੇ ਬਡੀਰੇ. ਤੁਮ ਹਉ; ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਝਗਰਤ ਪਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It is a sin to quarrel with the one who fathered and raised you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾ. ਤੁਮ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤ ਹਉ; ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਸਹਿ. ਨ ਆਪ ॥
The wealth you are so proud of has never belonged to anyone.
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸੁ; ਤਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
In an instant you will leave behind the taste of poisonous wealth, and then you will regret it. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਜਾਪ ॥
God is your Lord and Master; chant the chant of the Lord.
ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਤ. ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਕਉ; ਜਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ. ਤਉ ਜਾਇ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
Servant Nanak gives you this teaching; if you heed it, your suffering will go. ॥2॥1॥7॥
Sarang · Dupade Partal · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 5
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ. ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੋ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ; ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ; ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ, ਸਭ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mind, chant the Lord of the world, Master of the universe, Life of the world; I am in love with the Enticer of the mind; the Lord, Har Har Har, is my support, all day and all night. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਅਨਿਕ, ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ; ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ, ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਨਿਨ. ਨ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Countless are the Lord's praises; Sukdev, Narad, Brahma and others sing His countless virtues; Your virtues, O Master, cannot be counted.
ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ. ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ, ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ, ਆਪਨੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
You are infinite, O Lord, You are infinite, You are the Master; You alone know Your own ways. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ, ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟ ਹੀ ਬਸਤੇ; ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ, ਹਰਿ ਭਗਾਤ ॥
Those who dwell near the Lord, ever near Him, are the Lord's holy servants, His devotees.
ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ, ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ; ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਮਿਲਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੮॥
Those humble servants of the Lord merge with Him, O servant Nanak, as water mingles with water. ॥2॥1॥8॥
